description: We bring Glasgow's most curious students together to build, learn and turn bold ideas into real connections.
footerDescription: A student society at the University of Glasgow. Built by curious people, for curious people.
footerTagline: Made with care, and probably too much tea.

home.heroDescription: Hackathons, workshops, socials and a place to find your people in tech. Everyone curious is welcome.
aboutParagraphs: We're a student-run community at the University of Glasgow. We make space to experiment, learn from each other and have a good time doing it.
You don't need a polished portfolio or a perfect plan. Just turn up curious.
